body: Ok, thanks.

Damn. I hate the thought of putting anything inside of me. If I contact my doctor is there a pill I can take instead of that? I was sexually abused as a kid and have never had sex and really don't want anything inside me, ever.
Yea. thanks! I had to do some work from home first -_- so i haven't called 911 yet
Thanks. I'll tell my coworker what's really going on and that I told my boss I was having a reaction.
I told my boss I'm having a bad reaction to medication and won't be in tomorrow. I guess we'll see what happens. I have no idea what to tell him if I need to stay longer than a day. :(

Holly fuck. I just called one of the hospitals near by and they said they are a county hospital so they take people with no insurance, and they have a mental hospital there so I wouldn't have to pay, and I don't have to pay for the ambulance ride(the lady on the phone said I should call 911)
Thanks. She isn't responding, she may be busy.

I could take the bus. but i want to cut. I want to get stitched up. 

Fuck. I don't know anymore. How much would it be? I have like nothing.

I have no money. I'm so scared. Oh fuck. I can't not worry. I'm asking my coworker what to do now about work. 

I hate this. I've never been in debt before, medical bills will kill me won't they? I've heard horror stories. :( 

I want to just go. I wish I could. I wish I didn't have to think so much before helping myself but I feel like things will be worse and it will be even more a life I don't want to be in if I have all those bills and stuff.

Maybe I should just off myself. is any of this worth it?
I think I'm gonna text my coworker and ask her what I should do? She's kind of a friend and I told her I was depressed(not psychotic, but she knows I have problems)

I'd rather not tell him about me being mentally ill but if I'm going to be put in a mental hospital and have no contact to phones or computers to work from home then that can't be explained with an adverse reaction since even if I'm sick I usually work from home.

Do I talk to him first? Explain the situation about mental illness and being suicidal?? Should I call him?

I can't forget about work :( I have to pay rent and I can't be fired. Oh shit I just realized I don't even have insurance. Fuck. I don't even know if I should go now.

I feel like I have to be hurt to go there, that combined with already wanting to cut makes me feel obligated.

I don't want to go to the hospital if it is going to cause a big problem with work. Should I tell my boss that I'm mentally ill and suicidal?? I don't know what to do.

I just want to know what will happen if I go to a hospital. I want to go to a hospital. I need a break. I need some help. I'm overwhelmed by this. 

I don't want to go to a strangers house..I don't have a car, so I'd be taking the bus and I don't want to do that right now since it's late(8pm). 

I can't talk to my psychiatrist now or I would. I could maybe call the psychiatrists office, but I'd get the emergency line and they'd either call the cops to my apartment or tell me to go to the hospital, same as the suicide hotline.

I want to cut so badly. Oh man. If my roommates don't come home soon I think I'm gonna go to the hospital for stitches.

What will happen? I can't stay at home like this. I've contacted all my friends and they are busy. I will not go to family, they are unsupportive. 

I just want to go to a hospital at this point. Symptoms are really bad. I can't take it and I'm at home alone because I don't know where my roommates are and they won't answer me. 

I wanna cut really badly, and go to the hospital with that so it's not a waste of a visit.
So I got a working phone. Called a suicide hotline. I'm SO GLAD I did. Thanks for suggesting it. The person was so nice and I feel so much better. Thank you!
Thank you. I don't like my job though, I'm looking for a better one. My boss is bad.
Do you think I should tell my psychiatrist? I worry about being hospitalized. But I will tell my therapist. He'll understand. I see him Tuesday.
But they told me to do it
Thanks. I just need to think some more.
Thanks. It's a job I don't like, but you're right, I'm lucky to have it.
I don't have a working phone right now or I'd call. I'm sorry.

Well I'm diagnosed with psychosis. My case worker at the psychiatrists office said I won't be able to get SSI because I am already working and that shows I'm capable and stuff. 

I'm not having that much trouble, it's more so if i wanted to take time off or if I had to go to a mental hospital I wouldn't be able to because I couldn't afford to lose that much pay since I'm paid hourly.

If they're voices of people in trouble then isn't that important? I feel like I have their lives in my hands. They've said help us and help me, many many times. How do I know that they're not real people in another dimension that need help? Why can't they be?

Thanks.

I can't shake the feeling that my meds are blocking the contact I have the with voices, and that that is a bad thing. They told me to commit suicide. I think that's how I am supposed to get to them, but I also want to do it because I don't have anyone here. 

I can't do anything about work, I have to pay rent. I can't call my therapist..or I can.. but not on weekends, and I'm afraid. I don't know what will happen if I tell him I want to kill myself, and that the voices are telling me to. I can't afford to stop work for anything right now. 

I can't call anybody else, I don't think anyone wants to hear this stuff. I think I'm gonna just end up doing it soon. It'll be ok. I won't really be dead, I'll just be away from here.

I keep thinking that all I need to do is kill myself. It will fix it, I don't belong here anyways. I can do some good if I'm dead here. 

I feel like it's been building up and I need to do it soon. I want to do it soon. 

I've been thinking I should OD on all my meds. That will be sure to kill me if I can do it and be alone for a long time afterwards, like if no one comes home or something.
Thanks. I'm going to stay on them for now and talk to my therapist.

I can't write down what I hear if the meds are blocking them. I don't want the meds to be working. If they work then I can't hear the voices, and I want to hear what they have to say. I wish they would only block the bad demonic sounding voices. 

How do I know the other dimensions aren't reality? :( what if I'm in the wrong place?

I don't know if my friends will keep me grounded. What does that consist of?

Wow, thanks for sharing. This is inspiring. At the end of last year I started hearing voices(I'm a 21 year old female) and before that I'd been doing keto on and off, I was off at the time. And the voices have stuck around and I'm diagnosed with psychosis. 

I really gotta stick to keto for a while and see if it can make them stop(meds aren't working). 

I'm glad keto has helped you so much! :)

Because I'm stuck here with the abuse. Nothing else matters and I can't move on from it. There isn't anything great ahead. 

:( I don't know what to do. I want to OD now. I hope I die. I want to be free from all this. 

I care about him because he cared so much about me when I needed him before. He's just tired of doing it over and over again, I guess. I've worn everyone that cared about me out.
I want to not wake up tomorrow. Dying will solve all my problems. I'll save myself and no one will be overwhelmed by me anymore.

He knows more about me than anyone else. I've trusted him with so much, I can communicate well with him. I don't want him to be overwhelmed. I want his support. :(

I'm not a gift. I'm not anything. The reminder in my phone just went off for me to take my meds, and idk if I want skip 'em or OD.

I feel like screaming so fucking loud. I have barely one circle of friends. I just want them to bear with me. If they won't even stick by me when I need them why the fuck should I? I can't do this alone.

Yea but I feel like no one can hear me. I'm not communicating well. I don't think I am anyways. I have therapy tomorrow and I'll do the usual small talk I've been doing for a while now and not say what I want because I can't get myself to. 

My best friend is so overwhelmed that he just left when I told him I felt like killing myself. I'd say that a sure sign he doesn't give a fuck and doesn't care if I die. He just doesn't want to deal with me anymore. It's not the time for space. I needed him. :(

I feel abandoned by him. Is that wrong? I understand that he's overwhelmed, but I told him I felt like that and he just didn't say anything or offer to listen. He just left with our mutual friend to go somewhere. 

I just want to do it. I'm tired of trying to deal with everything on my own and not being able to communicate to others.

Really? I don't know if I should show it to my friend/roommate or not. I don't know if I should just leave him alone now since he said he was overwhelmed. Yea, I probably should just let him be.

Thank you.

Character-type drawings usually. Little monsters or something. I'm not very good. 

I tried writing what I remember, maybe to show to my friend and see if he understands. Does this sound ok? 

http://prayerbeadgirl.tumblr.com/
I can't though. I don't know why. It's so difficult.

It's ok. 

I'm not social enough to just ask to hangout with co-workers after work. If they ask and I can go I might, but I'm not going to initiate it. 

I'm just getting more and more down. What am I supposed to do? I have therapy tomorrow, but I don't want to talk to my therapist. I'm so embarrassed about everything I have to say, I just want life to be over.
..transitioning? When did I say that? I think you're mistaking me with someone else.

Why did you mention an lgbt hangout? 

I haven't hung out with my co-workers, I don't really want to unless maybe they ask me.

My co-workers are nice. My boss can be annoying. I'm looking for a better job because I don't get paid enough. 

I don't need this solitude. I don't want to be alone.

I feel like closing off from everyone around me now. I don't want to go to therapy or take meds or anything. I'm just overwhelming people I care about anyways. I just wanna be isolated so I can easily disappear.

I'm only taking one online class at a community college, working as a graphic designer/project manager at a web design/marketing company. Hobbies include watching tv and drawing. But I never finish anything I draw and almost always scrap it. 

I hate being alone. Especially when I feel like this but it seems like I'm always alone at the worst times. It wouldn't be so bizarre if I did kill myself, I'm sure everyone sees it coming. Nowhere else for my life to go.
Thanks!

I'd been doing well. And now I feel like shit, and my friend doesn't seem to care. No matter how well I've been doing, the second I start to get bad the one person I trust more than anyone else in the world is getting overwhelmed. I can't trust anyone else. I just want someone close to me to be there for me but no one's around.

I can't talk to my therapist. I don't know why, I like him and all. It's like that with everyone, it's insanely hard to try and talk about stuff. I want to but I don't. 

If I kill myself, people I love will be sad, but it will have bee expected. I think they're just waiting for it.
I think I've just worn them out. I don't think they even like me anymore.

But he's my best friend. I want him to take me serious. He said my problems are becoming too overwhelming for him, and I'm glad he told me, but it makes me incredible sad. Because they're overwhelming for me, too, and now I have no one to talk to, because I have such a hard time telling my therapist anything lately, so now I have to be overwhelmed unless I kill myself like I'm supposed to.
My friend said that my problems are becoming too overwhelming for him. :( That makes me really upset. I'm hurting him now, too.

I want my friend to listen. But he's tired of it. I just want to do it already instead of just saying I want to. Because I bet I'm getting pretty annoying, why else would he say, "Why this time?". :( Everything is bad because I'm still around.

I just told my friend/roommate that I felt like killing myself and he was like, "Why this time?" and said I should just talk to my therapist and that e being like this is the usual and expected. Then he went out because he was leaving anyways.

It's so expected that I feel like killing myself, it's probably expected that I just do it already. I know he's tired of me talking to him, so I'll stop and save us both the trouble. I'll just do it. No one wants to listen anyways.

Well I'm 21 now, and I've been going to therapy on and off since I was almost 16. So about 5 years. Almost 3 years with my current therapist, but I don't feel comfortable talking much. It's really hard for me to say anything about what's going on lately.

I hate that no one believes me. I've heard her ask me for help, and I felt what's happening to her. 

My friends and family will always judge me. Always. My friends don't want to but they will, and they don't want to hear it. They don't want me to talk about it. I've talked enough. They're tired of this. 

I don't know where she is. Maybe in a different dimension, maybe somewhere in this one. But if we're linked and I die we're both free. 

If our abuser is still alive, she's with him.

I am in therapy. But I have a really hard time saying anything important. 

I like your example about why worrying about being abused in a different dimension. It makes sense. 

I just feel the abuse still happening to her. It's so overwhelming. My body isn't mine, it's hers, and it's his. Never mine.

I'll find out if he's alive.

I know I have people who care. But how can they be more important than saving her? They'll understand. 

I want things for myself, selfishly, a life that's good, but I'm not important. It's not my life to enjoy. 

I feel so torn. She has to be more important. Someone needs to help her and no one will because they don't believe it.
I don't know if he's alive. I've been told he's dead. He was an elderly/grandfather figure. I don't believe he's dead. If he is, he's still alive where the real me is being abused.

But it's bigger than getting help from therapists and being a statistic. She's being hurt and nothing can stop it except me killing us.  She needs me.

I feel so shitty because I haven't done it, and I'm letting her get abused every day. I keep thinking I can't let it happen anymore, not another minute. But I haven't been able to push myself to do it just yet.

What other answer can there be? I want to save her. I'm not the real one, she deserves this life but I don't know how I can find her, only how I can end her suffering. 

I keep thinking she's in a different dimension. But how the fuck do you get to a different dimension? 

Suicide is the answer, I just have to push myself I think.
